name: @apprua/mcp
description: Apprua connector for AI apps (MCP): publish the apps you build with AI on your own Apprua server, from Claude, Codex, Cursor, VS Code and any app that supports MCP.
author: The Apprua authors

scripts.test: npm run build && esbuild src/pack.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=test/pack-under-test.mjs --log-level=warning --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs"
